title: perf(metadata-protocol): the served item read caches its caller-independent compiled answer (ADR-0156)
body:
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X7M2UeBw2UaWzE4U5gbL4AH)_ Fixes #34206 (the third of three changes ruled in 6920925378: the cascade-delete memo #34437, merged as `d18d54bd`; ADR-0156 #34464, merged as `f8066085`; then this cache). Clause-②: yes Metadata-protocol: none ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么:按 ADR-0156 给元数据的单项读取(应用包里每个应用、对象、视图、页面、仪表盘都走它)加了一层共享编译缓存,只存所有人共用的编译结果;权限门、字段遮罩、翻译、ETag 和实时附带信息每次请求照算。为此三个来源各自记变更:对象注册表、元数据服务、`sys_metadata` 行。 - 为什么改:你 6920925378 裁决 B。Setup 应用包一次重复请求的数据库读取从 213 次降到 9 次,隔一分钟以上再打开的请求也受益,不会串权限。 - 风险与回滚:最坏情况是另一个进程改了元数据,本进程最多 30 秒后才看到(和现有行缓存同一个上限);本进程内的改动立即生效。`OS_METADATA_COMPILE_CACHE_TTL_MS=0` 就是原来的不缓存路径,回滚也可以直接撤这个 PR。 - 先看:`packages/metadata-protocol/src/meta-compile-cache.ts` 的文件头(缓存什么、每个来源靠什么失效、到期怎么确认),再看 `packages/objectql/src/registry-revision.ts`(注册表每个公开方法登记为读或写,漏登记编译不过)。 - 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/meta-compile-cache.test.ts`,预期 27 个全过。 - 需要你做的:暂无;席位安排契约复审,通过后落地。 ## What changes ADR-0156 implemented for the served item read (`getMetaItem`, the face `GET /api/v1/meta/:type/:name` and every app bundle member read go through). - **`packages/metadata-protocol/src/meta-compile-cache.ts`** (new): a per-engine cache of the compiled envelope of a by-name read of `app`, `object`, `view`, `page` and `dashboard`. A read naming a package, a state, a member or a draft preview is never cached. - **Stamp (D1 (a), D2).** Each entry is held under the stamp of every in-process counter it read: the `sys_metadata` overlay generation, `SchemaRegistry#objectRevision` and the new `SchemaRegistry#revision`, and the metadata service's identity and new `revision`. Any move drops every entry (one bucket per engine). A source without its counter makes the cache decline: a registry without `revision`, a metadata service without `revision`, an engine without the write-epoch seam. - **Bound and confirmation (D1 (b), D5).** At the bound (`OS_METADATA_COMPILE_CACHE_TTL_MS`, default 30000 ms, same parse as the overlay knob) the cache reads the store (bookkeeping columns of `sys_metadata` plus an age cap (see delta 6933554702), as the system; each confirmation also retires the overlay row cache, a compile in flight across a confirmation is not stored, and no entry is renewed past 10 bounds) and each loader's change mark. If both equal the last confirmed reading, the entries stand for another bound; otherwise they all go. If any reading is unavailable, nothing is renewed: the entries go and the bucket keeps no reading, so whatever is compiled under it lives one bound at most. A store fault at the confirmation is thrown as the uncached read throws it (`metadataReadFailureError`; an unprovisioned `sys_metadata` reads as "no reading"). - **Per source, which D5 branch (review#2 N6).** `sys_metadata` rows: observed (store reading). Files under a running process: observed (`FilesystemLoader#changeMark`). A `memory:` loader: in-process, seen by the service's `revision`. Any other loader without `changeMark` (a `datasource:` or `http:` loader): the recompile-at-bound branch, never renewed. No shipped composition registers one (`MetadataPlugin` builds its manager with the file loader only). - **Caller independence (D3).** The cached envelope is computed by the served face with no caller. The live trailers (`registration`, `disabledActions`, `cascadeDeleteObjects`) are stripped before storing and read again on every hit, so a trailer the live read no longer answers is absent. Every store and every serve is a `structuredClone`; the served-row change time is carried beside the envelope. - **Hydration (D4).** The served item read registers nothing in the registry; a hit leaves the registry exactly as a miss does. The list read (`getMetaItems`), which hydrates, is not cached. - **Knob (D6).** `0` is the uncached read: the same reads in the same order (pinned against a harness the cache declines). - **`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-item-reads.ts`**: `getMetaItem` reads through the cache. The three live trailers move into one exported `liveItemTrailers` used by both `readMetaItem` and a hit, so they are computed one way. - **`packages/objectql/src/registry-revision.ts`** (new) and **`registry.ts`**: `SchemaRegistry#revision`. Every public method is classified once as `read` or `write` in `SCHEMA_REGISTRY_METHOD_KINDS`, a `Record` over every public method name, so a new public method fails the type check until it is classified. Each `write` is wrapped at the prototype to move the counter before, after (also when it throws) and after a returned promise settles. ADR-0127 D2: the counter is owned at the source's own boundary, not kept as a list of call sites. - **`packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager.ts`**: `MetadataManager#revision`, moved in the in-memory store funnel (`writeRegistryEntry`, `deleteRegistryEntries`), `invalidateListCache` (every stored-set mutation the manager learns of), `notifyWatchersLocal`, `registerLoader` and `setTypeRegistry`; and `loaderChangeMark()`. - **`packages/metadata/src/loaders/loader-interface.ts`** and **`filesystem-loader.ts`**: the optional `MetadataLoader#changeMark()`, and the file loader's: one `stat` per type directory a read probed and per file a read resolved (a file created where a miss was remembered, edited or removed moves it). - **`content/docs/deployment/environment-variables.mdx`**: the new knob's row, beside the overlay knob. - **`scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json`**: the new test file's engine double, recorded by `--write`. ## Tests - `packages/metadata-protocol/src/meta-compile-cache.test.ts` (36). Repeat reads zero sources; cached ≡ uncached for each cached type (against the knob at `0`); a copy per call; live trailers read on every hit, and an absent one stays absent; D4 registry untouched. D7 retire pins, one per source, each with the new value in the next answer where it has one: a `sys_metadata` write, `registry.revision`, `objectRevision`, a registry item change, the service's `revision` and another service in its slot; controls: a write to another object and a plain repeat keep the entry. D2 declines: no registry `revision`, no service `revision`, no write-epoch seam; no metadata service at all still caches. D6: TTL `0` makes the same reads as a declined harness; the knob's parse. D5 with a mocked clock: nothing moved renews; another writer's row is seen at the bound; a loader mark move drops; a write that lands while the confirmation awaits the store is not hidden; a store outage fails the read with the driver error as cause and serves nothing; an unprovisioned store recompiles; ⛔ a source the confirmation cannot observe is never renewed (D7's added pin). - `packages/objectql/src/registry-revision.test.ts` (7): every classified name is a method and exactly the writes are wrapped; each of nine writes moves `revision`; a view registration moves it where `objectRevision` stays; a throwing write moves it; control: eleven reads leave it alone; per-registry counters; installing twice does not double-wrap. - `packages/objectql/src/engine-cascade-delete-objects.test.ts` (+3, L1 N1 on #34437): a package disable moves `objectRevision` and the next answer drops the child only the disabled extension made; an enable restores it; a refused registration run retires an answer memoized inside the run. - `packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager-change-revision.test.ts` (9): the manager's `revision` moves on register, re-register, unregister, a new loader and a new type registry, and in the store funnel on its own (the rollback path); control: reads leave it alone. `loaderChangeMark` skips `memory:` loaders and is `undefined` for a loader without a mark or whose mark throws. The file loader's mark moves on a file created where a miss was remembered, an in-place edit and a removal; control: a change in a directory no read probed leaves it.
Ablations (12, each through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, each restored to the HEAD blob) | Mutation | Red | |:--|:--| | a hit skips the stamp re-read | the confirmation race pin | | the bucket is not reset on a stamp change | 5 retire pins (rows, `revision`, `objectRevision`, registry item, service) | | the confirmation never drops entries | 3 D5 pins (store moved, loader mark moved, unobservable source) | | an unreadable mark renews | the unobservable-source pin | | a hit is served without a clone | the copy-per-call pin | | trailers are stored with the entry | the absent-trailer pin | | a store fault at the confirmation reads as "no reading" | the store outage pin | | registry writes are not wrapped | 5 registry revision pins | | the file loader does not record probed directories | the remembered-miss pin | | the manager's store funnel does not count | the store funnel pin | | a loader without a mark is skipped | the markless loader pin |
## Acceptance (ruling item 5) Readings on one shared box, showcase `--fresh`, seeded admin, `X-OS-Debug-Timing: 1`, `meta` in ms; before is `main` d5e6b202 with the same build, after is this change. Absolutes are about a shared box; the database read counts are not. | Case | Before | After | |:--|:--|:--| | Setup bundle, immediate repeat | ~141 (131 to 145), 213 database reads | ~110 (92 to 124), 9 database reads | | Setup bundle, 304 | ~154 (121 to 178) | ~90 (83 to 100) | | Setup bundle, reload 65 s after the previous call | 426 / 372 / 402 (218 reads) | at `e350186c` (comment 6933083314): first bound 446 (warm-up recompile), then 176 / 154 (42 reads against 220); repeat and 304 unchanged at 9 reads | | showcase_app bundle, repeat | 62 to 89 | ~46 | | showcase_app bundle, 304 | 63 to 81 | 47 to 72 | The response bodies are byte-identical (md5) and the `ETag` is the same before and after. cloud#4563 acceptance 1 is judged on its staging reading. **At `b7751333` (delta 6933554702) and `3fa027d4` (delta 6933725901, review#2 S4 and L1 M1):** the store confirmation no longer digests row content. It reads bookkeeping columns plus an age cap; readings on a seeded 5 000-row store are in that delta. Where the Acceptance, Gates and D5 text above says otherwise, it describes `e350186c`, and the delta comment governs. Follow-up: #34522 (a write-moved column on `sys_metadata`), filed unclaimed. ## Verification
Gates and tests (head 00fef25c) - `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 104 commands derived at first, 112 after the ledger file joined the diff; all 112 run locally under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`. Four were red on the first run and are fixed in this head: `check:durability-log-level` (the confirmation's store read now rethrows a non-benign fault), `check:test-source-alias` (the new test pays `@objectstack/lint` at collection), `check:engine-double-contract` (ledger recorded), and `check:adr-anchors` (ADR-0156 was not on `main` yet; green after #34464 merged). - Package suites: `pnpm --filter test` under the verify lock, on the B commits over `main` d5e6b202 with a full build: `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` 347 files, 22995 passed, 45 skipped (rerun on the final code); `@objectstack/metadata` 2631 passed; `@objectstack/objectql` 13514 passed; `@objectstack/rest` 8564 passed, 350 skipped; `@objectstack/runtime` 609 files, 11290 tests, 11271 passed, 19 skipped; all exit 0. `pnpm --filter typecheck` exit 0 for metadata-protocol, metadata and objectql (objectql's `check:test-typecheck` debt unchanged). `--ran` reconciliation: "112 derived, 112 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN", exit 0 (record: `/mnt/project-files/pm-orders/objectstack/34206-B-gates-ran.txt`, project files). - `git merge-tree --write-tree` against every open pull request sharing a file: clean for #34347, #34333, #34429 and #34477; #30297 and #30657 are drafts based far behind `main` whose diffs touch every file here and do not merge-tree at all. - Families CI owns (the type-check lanes, Build Core, Test Core shards, the artifact rosters and the repo-wide `pnpm lint`) are read from this PR's check runs. - Dogfood battery: not owed (no `!` in the title, no `(narrowing)` arm).
